external_id.description: A user provided id that can be used to link an account holder with an external system

individual.description: Information on individual for whom the account is being opened and KYC is being run.

kyc_passed_timestamp.description:
An RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when precomputed KYC was completed on the individual with a pass result.

This field is required only if workflow type is `KYC_BYO`.

tos_timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when the account holder accepted the applicable legal agreements (e.g., cardholder terms) as agreed upon during API customer's implementation with Lithic.

workflow.description: Specifies the type of KYC workflow to run.
